description: Draw these exact eight sampling edges as an aligned waveform or timing table. Emphasize the stall then three consecutive transfers. Do not invent delays or transactions.

spec.title: Ready/Valid Stall and Consecutive Transfers
spec.summary: Original generic synthetic benchmark. Given facts belong to this example only; this is not a measured commercial design.

nodes.label: clk
nodes.detail: All c0..c7 columns are rising sampling edges

nodes.label: data
nodes.detail: c0..c7: - - A A A B C -

steps: c2: valid=1, ready=0, data=A; no transfer.
c3: valid=1, ready=0, data=A; no transfer.
c4: valid=1, ready=1, data=A; transfer A.
c5: valid=1, ready=1, data=B; transfer B.
c6: valid=1, ready=1, data=C; transfer C.
annotations: Each column describes signal values sampled immediately before that rising edge. Changes after an edge belong to the next column.
transfer = rst_n && valid && ready. A remains stable during c2 and c3 stall and through its c4 acceptance.
This is one generic ready/valid channel, not an AXI bus or measured waveform.

settings.notes: Exact supplied timing trace. Keep all six signal rows and c0..c7 sample values.
